E9a_binary_criterion.note: The criterion is compared against a direct grid count of the admissible gauge set. Disagreements at the boundary are expected because the grid resolves the set only to its spacing.

E9b_unified_radius.estimator: maximum l1 displacement over the pooled directions from six seeds, 4000 directions each
E9b_unified_radius.supersedes: Table 3 previously reported 1.091 from a three-seed mean of per-seed maxima and 1.054 from a single-seed maximum. Both were lower bounds on the same supremum under different budgets. This value replaces them.
